name: Crunchmaster Multi-Grain 6-Seed Crunchy Baked Rice Crackers
ingredientsText: Brown rice flour, sesame seeds, potato starch, flax seeds, olive oil, amaranth seeds, quinoa seeds, chia seeds, sea salt, tamari soy sauce powder (tamari soy sauce [soybeans, salt], maltodextrin, salt), millet.
mayContainStatement: Produced in a facility that also uses milk and tree nuts.
